task: score distribution statistics by group_id: overall (output_1.csv) + monthly by apply_date[:6] (output_2.csv)

method.environment: pure Python standard library (pandas/numpy NOT installed in this environment); csv + collections.Counter + statistics
method.loading: csv.DictReader with encoding='utf-8-sig' (strips BOM); score parsed to float; apply_month = apply_date[:6]; rows missing any of the 3 fields or failing parse are skipped and counted (actual skipped = 0)
method.accumulation: single pass; each row appended both to key (group_id, apply_month) and (group_id, 'overall'); the 'overall' marker is an internal accumulator key only and is NOT emitted as a column

metrics.cnt: float(len(values)) - cast to float per spec (written as e.g. 420.0)
metrics.mode_score: Counter-based mode with MIN tie-break: min of all scores sharing the highest frequency (not Counter.most_common, whose tie order is insertion-dependent)
metrics.median_score: statistics.median (average of two middle values for even n)

method.ordering: output_1 sorted by group_id; output_2 sorted by (group_id, apply_month); sparse grid - only observed (group, month) pairs emitted
method.formatting: all values rounded to 10 decimal places and written via repr(float); cnt remains integral (e.g. 420.0)

validation.independent_recompute_max_abs_diff: 4.05e-11 (manual mean/median/sqrt(ddof=1) formulas vs output_1) - rounding only

notes: 5 duplicate full rows exist in the raw data and were intentionally KEPT (no dedup in spec); counts sum to 1203 either way as expected.
Sparse (group, month) grid: 32 observed cells out of the 42 possible group x month combinations; missing combinations are not emitted.
G003 max_score 999.0 is the dataset maximum (per data_profile) and is retained as a legitimate value.
